scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,app -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w app
scripts.test: npm run test -w db-tests && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w app
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w app && npm run typecheck:functions && npm run typecheck -w db-tests
scripts.insforge:migrate: node scripts/check-insforge-project.mjs && npx -y @insforge/cli db migrations up --all
